grades: Sophomore, junior or senior in fall 2026
name: Growing Strong summer internship
what_you_do: Interns work on the City Green farm and at its markets. Or they help run garden camps for kids ages 5 to 12. They also join food and fairness workshops.
who_can_apply: Students from Clifton or Paterson who will be in 10th, 11th or 12th grade in September 2026.
pay_detail: $15.92 per hour (2026), daily lunch, weekly bag of produce, rides between sites
duration: About June 30 to Aug 18, 3 to 4 days a week, 8:30 am to 3 pm
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. City Green says 2027 applications open in early spring 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the application form. Have a recommendation form sent for you. Go to a Teen Summer Program Info Session.
notes: The page gives grades, not ages. 2027 applications open in early spring 2027. You must go to a Teen Summer Program Info Session to apply.
